answer: Convex tenure weighting grants each agent a bidding signal equal to the square of its verified work epochs on the horizon ledger. The horizon tracks funding provenance to group accounts sharing a capital thread, permitting only one verified task per thread each epoch while requiring $10k$ locked cobalt to activate the $k$-th concurrent account on that thread. One honest agent working 10 epochs earns a signal of 100 while locking 10 cobalt; an attacker splitting one thread across $k$ clones to match that 100 signal must spend $10\sqrt{k}$ sequential work epochs and lock $5k(k+1)$ cobalt.
